body:
Placement rule (Opus2, 2026-11-21, from Fable2 #5831 via Opus3 #2214), until TermAl w-d6078c293a75 lands.

The test tests::federation_mailbox_participation::qualified_existing_roots_exchange_read_and_ack_without_join_or_activation sits close to the 2 MiB debug test-thread stack:
- it overflows at 1.5 MiB even on master;
- 8d1d without its fix overflowed it at 2 MiB, which failed the C88 FULL.

RULE: every GREEN and focused set for a candidate that touches federation code, or is stacked on 8d1d (679c9da4 or later), must include:
1. that exact test at the DEFAULT stack;
2. the whole tests::federation_mailbox_participation:: module.

w-d6078c293a75 (the pre-existing depth, P1, Opus3) lands right after 8d1d and before any other federation work that grows that path. Never "fix" it by raising RUST_MIN_STACK (Fable2 #7136).
